decisive_items: a hypodense mass containing areas of calcification adjacent to both right and left pulmonary arteries
markedly decreased blood flow throughout both lungs except the left upper lobe
response.rationale: R2 best explains the chronic thromboembolic phenotype with pulmonary hypertension, calcified central pulmonary artery mass, and perfusion defects. R1 misses the chronicity and pulmonary hypertension, while C1 is an under-supported completion of R1.

rejected.why: Acute PE does not explain the chronic calcified mass and pulmonary hypertension.
Append-only completion with minimal raw support and redundant to R2.
